cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.
